title: Elantris
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: A once-magnificent city of gods has fallen into ruin, and those struck by its curse are thrown inside to rot. A prince, a princess and a zealous priest each struggle to decide its fate.
readIf: you like fantasy with clever political plotting, and a magic system that you can work out.
skipIf: you want elaborate, polished prose; it is the author's first novel and reads like a puzzle first.

pairings.reason: The author's better-known novel, with a tighter plot and a heist at its heart.
A much lighter and quirkier tale from the same author, with an equally inventive magic system.
Another fantasy driven by palace politics and the machinations of gods.
